reading.distinction: This reading treats 'should not' as an operative prohibition that is removed when additional controls are present and proper. A guidance reading would instead identify discouraged conduct under the same factual conditions; the excerpt does not resolve that difference in normative force. Removal of this restriction establishes no overall product approval.
